criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given the Beacon view loads, when filter options are retrieved, then the available Beacon groups and profiles are shown without duplicate option labels.
criterionOutcomes.reason: Direct screenshots show the Group and Profile controls and retrieved options with distinct labels.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given a user selects a group, when the filter is applied, then the map shows only Beacons assigned to that group.
criterionOutcomes.reason: The refreshed view showed no Beacons available, so matching Beacon assignment was not directly verified.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given a user selects a profile, when the filter is applied, then the map shows only Beacons assigned to that profile.
criterionOutcomes.reason: The Profile control was visible, but no independent profile-filter result was captured.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given a user selects both a group and a profile, when the filters are applied, then the map shows only Beacons that match both selections.
criterionOutcomes.reason: Both controls were visible, but no independent combined-filter result was captured.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given the selected filters return no matching Beacons, when the view refreshes, then no map markers are shown while the map and filters remain usable.
criterionOutcomes.reason: Direct screenshot evidence shows the no-results state after filtering while the view remains usable.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given a user changes either filter, when the refreshed results are displayed, then previous map results are not retained.
criterionOutcomes.reason: Previous Beacon result retention could not be independently confirmed from the available result set.
